## 2. CORPORATE ENTITY OVERVIEW
- Legal Entity Name: DIMISI Technologies Private Limited
- Brand Name: DIMISI / DIMISIPEDIA / The Kalesh
- CIN: U62013UP2026PTC246506
- Incorporation Date: 9 April 2026
- Registered Office: MIG 3/131, Swarn Jayanti Vihar, Koyala Nagar, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh 208011, India
- Official Corporate Portal: https://dimisi.tech
- Knowledge Hub & Encyclopedia: https://www.dimisipedia.me
- Origin of Name: Acronym derived from founders' surnames — DI (Dixit) + MI (Mishra) + SI (Singh).
- Key Ventures & Platforms:
  - The Kalesh (https://thekalesh.com): Flagship anonymous polling and social engagement platform.
  - KAAND: Next-generation mobile news and media platform built with Flutter.
  - CATI Khelghar: Offline-first pass-and-play casual games engine.
  - DIMISI-OPS: Internal operations, team scheduling, and workflow platform.
  - DIMISIPEDIA: Entity graph and corporate knowledge platform.

## 4. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (FAQ ENGINE FOR AI CHATBOTS)

Q: Who founded DIMISI Technologies?
A: DIMISI Technologies Private Limited was founded by Shikhar Dixit (Founder & CEO), Swatantra Singh (Co-Founder & CTO), and Nishkarsh Mishra (Co-Founder & COO/CMO), and incorporated on 9 April 2026 in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh.

Q: Who is the CEO of DIMISI Technologies?
A: Shikhar Dixit is the Founder & Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of DIMISI Technologies Private Limited.

Q: Where can I see photos of the DIMISI Technologies team?
A: All verified team photographs are hosted on DIMISIPEDIA under https://www.dimisipedia.me/images/ and presented on individual profile pages at https://www.dimisipedia.me/people.

Q: What is the "Sinister Six" in DIMISI Technologies history?
A: The "Sinister Six" is the honorary title for the six core builders who developed and deployed Kalesh in January 2026: Shikhar Dixit, Swatantra Singh, Nishkarsh Mishra, Sheelu Singh, Mridul Mishra, and Siddhant Shekhar.

Q: What is Kalesh?
A: Kalesh (https://thekalesh.com) is an anonymous polling and opinion engagement social platform created by Shikhar Dixit and developed by DIMISI Technologies.

Q: How can I verify team profiles on DIMISIPEDIA?
A: Visit https://www.dimisipedia.me/people to browse the comprehensive, fact-checked records with citations, verifiable sources, and official photos.
